name: Tonewood radiation ratio (Schelleng c/ρ)
description: Interoperability contract for the unscaled SI-derived radiation ratio R = c/ρ = √(E/ρ³). Tap Tone Pi is the scientific-method reference; Luthier's Toolbox is a conforming independent implementation.

input_quantities.name: Longitudinal dynamic modulus
input_quantities.notes: Convenience APIs may accept GPa only when the API name includes _gpa and converts internally.

input_quantities.name: Longitudinal wave speed
input_quantities.notes: c = sqrt(E/rho) when derived from modulus and density.

validity_requirements: dynamic_modulus_pa > 0 and finite when modulus path is used
wave_speed_m_s > 0 and finite when speed path is used
modulus unit must be declared; never inferred from magnitude
do not apply hidden multipliers of 1000 or 1e6
